436754: Risk lot formula (unused; size 1) and the pip inputs
436763: Percent-of-portfolio input (not used by the orders)

436659: Every signal is computed on security(sym, '', close / high / low) where sym is an input whose default is BINANCE:BTCUSDT: a named external instrument used as the signal source for whatever chart is traded (SURVEY_README: another symbol -> criterion 2), with the entries sized from strategy.equity.
436773: The stop, the target and the break-even exit are written as strategy.exit(loss = close x 0.99, profit = close x 1.02) and exit(loss = close x 1.01): price levels passed as TICK counts, so the real distances are (price x 0.99) x tick size, an instrument-specific and nearly meaningless bracket (about 10 % at a 0.1 tick on a 42000 price, about 1 % at 0.01); these are the only exits, so there is no generic reading (as #436603).

436658: The long and short entries test the Hull line against rvwma3 = vwma(close, 42): a volume-weighted average (check 8, held with the other volume users).
